content.answer_markdown: The Assistant requires an LLM Exchange to be selected because the detailed content of an LLM Exchange—such as the system text, prompt, and reply—is only available when a specific Exchange is opened. Without selecting an Exchange, the Assistant has no data from that Exchange to analyze or discuss. This ensures that the Assistant's responses are grounded in the actual recorded interactions rather than general or assumed information.

citations.figure: note: No LLM Exchange is selected, so none is included. Open one to ask about it.

claims.text: The Assistant can only discuss an LLM Exchange when it is selected because the system text, prompt, and reply of that Exchange are included only upon selection.

follow_up_questions: How can I select an LLM Exchange to view its details?
What information is contained in an LLM Exchange?
